## JSON functions

SELECT JSON_EXTRACT('{x', '$')
=> null

SELECT JSON_EXTRACT_SCALAR('"s"')
=> "s"

SELECT JSON_VALUE(JSON '{"a": true}', '$.a')
=> "true"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON_QUERY(JSON '{"a": null}', '$.a'))
=> "null"

SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH(JSON_QUERY_ARRAY('[]'))
=> "0"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON_VALUE_ARRAY('[1, null, "s"]'))
=> "[\"1\",null,\"s\"]"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(JSON_EXTRACT_STRING_ARRAY(JSON '[true]'), ',')
=> "true"

SELECT JSON_TYPE(JSON '[1]')
=> "array"

SELECT JSON_TYPE(JSON '1.5')
=> "number"

SELECT JSON_TYPE(JSON 'null')
=> "null"

SELECT JSON_TYPE(CAST(NULL AS JSON))
=> null

SELECT JSON_QUERY('{"a": null}', '$.a')
=> null

SELECT JSON_QUERY(JSON '{"a": null}', '$.b') IS NULL
=> "true"

SELECT JSON_VALUE('{"a": null}', '$.a')
=> null

SELECT JSON_QUERY('{"a": "x\\u00e9\\n"}', '$.a')
=> "\"xé\\n\""

SELECT JSON_VALUE('{"a": "x\\u00e9\\n"}', '$.a')
=> "xé\n"

SELECT JSON_QUERY('{"a.b": 1}', '$."a.b"')
=> "1"

SELECT JSON_EXTRACT('{"a.b": 1}', "$['a.b']")
=> "1"

SELECT JSON_VALUE(JSON '{"a": 12345678901234567}', '$.a')
=> "12345678901234567"

SELECT SAFE.JSON_QUERY('{}', 'a')
=> null

SELECT SAFE.JSON_QUERY('{}', '$[a]')
=> null

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON_QUERY(JSON '{"a": [{"b": 1}, {"b": 2}]}', 'lax $.a.b'))
=> "[1,2]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON_QUERY_ARRAY('[1, null, {"a": 2}, "s"]'))
=> "[\"1\",\"null\",\"{\\\"a\\\":2}\",\"\\\"s\\\"\"]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON_QUERY_ARRAY(JSON '[1, null, {"a": 2}]'))
=> "[1,null,{\"a\":2}]"

SELECT JSON_VALUE_ARRAY('[1, [2]]') IS NULL
=> "true"

SELECT JSON_TYPE(JSON '-0.0')
=> "number"

SELECT JSON_QUERY('{"a": {"b": [1, null, {"c": "x"}, "s"]}}', '$.a.b[2]')
=> "{\"c\":\"x\"}"

SELECT JSON_QUERY('{"k.l": 2}', '$."k.l"')
=> "2"

SELECT JSON_EXTRACT('{"k.l": 2}', "$['k.l']")
=> "2"

SELECT JSON_QUERY('{"n": null}', '$.n')
=> null

SELECT JSON_QUERY('{"n": null}', '$.missing')
=> null

SELECT JSON_VALUE('{"a": {"b": [1, null, {"c": "x"}, "s"]}}', '$.a.b[3]')
=> "s"

SELECT JSON_VALUE('{"a": {"b": [1, null, {"c": "x"}, "s"]}}', '$.a.b[0]')
=> "1"

SELECT JSON_VALUE('{"a": {"b": [1, null, {"c": "x"}, "s"]}}', '$.a')
=> null

SELECT JSON_EXTRACT_ARRAY('{"a": {"b": 1}}', '$.a') IS NULL
=> "true"

# An array with a non-scalar element has no scalar values.
SELECT JSON_VALUE_ARRAY('{"a": {"b": [1, null, {"c": "x"}, "s"]}}', '$.a.b') IS NULL
=> "true"

## Builds and changes JSON

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(TO_JSON(STRUCT(1 AS a, [2, 3] AS b)))
=> "{\"a\":1,\"b\":[2,3]}"

# STRUCT<> values encode as GoogleSQL compliance data in functions_testlib_tojson.cc does.
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(STRUCT())
=> "{}"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(STRUCT(), true)
=> "{}"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(CAST(NULL AS STRUCT<>))
=> "null"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(TO_JSON(STRUCT([10, 11] AS a, CAST(NULL AS STRUCT<>) AS c, STRUCT() AS x)))
=> "{\"a\":[10,11],\"c\":null,\"x\":{}}"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON_ARRAY(STRUCT(), [STRUCT()]))
=> "[{},[{}]]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON_OBJECT('a', STRUCT()))
=> "{\"a\":{}}"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON_SET(JSON '{}', '$.a', STRUCT()))
=> "{\"a\":{}}"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(TO_JSON(CAST(NULL AS INT64)))
=> "null"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(TO_JSON('s', stringify_wide_numbers => FALSE))
=> "\"s\""

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON_OBJECT('a', 1, 'b', NULL, 'c', JSON '[1]'))
=> "{\"a\":1,\"b\":null,\"c\":[1]}"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON_OBJECT())
=> "{}"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON_OBJECT('a', 1, 'a', 2))
=> "{\"a\":1}"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON_OBJECT(['a', 'b'], [10, 20]))
=> "{\"a\":10,\"b\":20}"

SELECT JSON_REMOVE(CAST(NULL AS JSON), '$.a')
=> null

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON_SET(JSON '{}', '$.a', CAST(NULL AS INT64)))
=> "{\"a\":null}"

SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH(JSON_KEYS(JSON '[]'))
=> "0"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(JSON_KEYS(JSON '[{"a": 1}]', mode => 'lax'), ',')
=> "a"

SELECT LAX_BOOL(JSON '"TRUE"')
=> "true"

SELECT LAX_INT64(JSON '"10"')
=> "10"

SELECT LAX_INT64(JSON '1.5')
=> "2"

SELECT LAX_INT64(JSON '[1]')
=> null

SELECT LAX_FLOAT64(JSON '"1.5"')
=> "1.5"

SELECT LAX_STRING(JSON '123')
=> "123"

SELECT LAX_STRING(CAST(NULL AS JSON))
=> null

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(1e20)
=> "1e+20"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(-0.0)
=> "0"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(CAST('nan' AS FLOAT64))
=> "\"NaN\""

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(9007199254740992)
=> "9007199254740992"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(9007199254740993)
=> "\"9007199254740993\""

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(STRUCT(NUMERIC '1' AS n, NUMERIC '1.5' AS f, BIGNUMERIC '-0.5' AS b))
=> "{\"n\":1,\"f\":\"1.5\",\"b\":\"-0.5\"}"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(STRUCT(b'\xff' AS b, TIMESTAMP '2020-01-01 00:00:00.5+00' AS t,
  DATETIME '2020-01-01 01:02:03' AS d, TIME '01:02:03.25' AS ti))
=> "{\"b\":\"/w==\",\"t\":\"2020-01-01T00:00:00.500Z\",\"d\":\"2020-01-01T01:02:03\",\"ti\":\"01:02:03.250\"}"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING('"<\u2028\x01é')
=> "\"\\\"<\\u2028\\u0001é\""

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(STRUCT(1 AS a, [JSON '{"x" : 1}'] AS b), true)
=> "{\n  \"a\": 1,\n  \"b\": [\n    {\n      \"x\": 1\n    }\n  ]\n}"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(CAST(NULL AS INT64))
=> "null"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(1, CAST(NULL AS BOOL))
=> null

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(TO_JSON(9007199254740993))
=> "9007199254740993"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(TO_JSON(9007199254740993, stringify_wide_numbers => TRUE))
=> "\"9007199254740993\""

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(TO_JSON(NUMERIC '99999999999999999999.5', stringify_wide_numbers => TRUE))
=> "\"99999999999999999999.5\""

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(TO_JSON(NUMERIC '99999999999999999999.5'))
=> "1e+20"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(TO_JSON(STRUCT(1.5 AS f, TIMESTAMP '2020-01-01 00:00:00+00' AS t)))
=> "{\"f\":1.5,\"t\":\"2020-01-01T00:00:00Z\"}"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(PARSE_JSON('{"a" : 1.50, "b": [1, 2]}'))
=> "{\"a\":1.5,\"b\":[1,2]}"

SELECT SAFE.PARSE_JSON('{"a": 1,}')
=> null

SELECT SAFE.PARSE_JSON('12345678901234567890123')
=> null

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(PARSE_JSON('12345678901234567890123', wide_number_mode => 'round'))
=> "1.2345678901234568e+22"

SELECT SAFE.PARSE_JSON('1', wide_number_mode => 'x')
=> null

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON_ARRAY(1.5, CAST('nan' AS FLOAT64), b'\x01', NUMERIC '1.5', 9007199254740993))
=> "[1.5,\"NaN\",\"AQ==\",1.5,9007199254740993]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON_ARRAY())
=> "[]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON_ARRAY(NULL, [1, 2]))
=> "[null,[1,2]]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON_OBJECT('a', 1e20, 'b', b'\x01'))
=> "{\"a\":1e+20,\"b\":\"AQ==\"}"

SELECT SAFE.JSON_OBJECT(['a', NULL], [1, 2])
=> null

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON_SET(JSON '{"a": 1}', '$.a', [1e20], '$.b', JSON 'null'))
=> "{\"a\":[1e+20],\"b\":null}"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON_REMOVE(JSON '{"a": {"b": 1, "c": null}, "d": [1, null, 2]}', '$.a.b', '$.d[0]'))
=> "{\"a\":{\"c\":null},\"d\":[null,2]}"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON_REMOVE(JSON '{"a": {"b": 1, "c": null}, "d": [1, null, 2]}', '$.x', NULL))
=> "{\"a\":{\"b\":1,\"c\":null},\"d\":[1,null,2]}"

SELECT JSON_REMOVE(CAST(NULL AS JSON), 'a')
=> error:

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON_SET(JSON '{"a": {"b": 1, "c": null}, "d": [1, null, 2]}', '$.a.b', 'x', '$.e.f', [1]))
=> "{\"a\":{\"b\":\"x\",\"c\":null},\"d\":[1,null,2],\"e\":{\"f\":[1]}}"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON_SET(JSON '{"a": {"b": 1, "c": null}, "d": [1, null, 2]}', '$.e', 1, create_if_missing => FALSE))
=> "{\"a\":{\"b\":1,\"c\":null},\"d\":[1,null,2]}"

# A path through a scalar is ignored.
SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON_SET(JSON '{"a": {"b": 1, "c": null}, "d": [1, null, 2]}', '$.a.b.c', 1))
=> "{\"a\":{\"b\":1,\"c\":null},\"d\":[1,null,2]}"

SELECT JSON_SET(JSON '{"a": 1}', 'a', 1)
=> error:

SELECT JSON_OBJECT(['a'], [1, 2])
=> error:

SELECT JSON_OBJECT(CAST(NULL AS STRING), 1)
=> error:

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON_STRIP_NULLS(JSON '{"a": {"b": 1, "c": null}, "d": [1, null, 2]}'))
=> "{\"a\":{\"b\":1},\"d\":[1,2]}"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON_STRIP_NULLS(JSON '{"a": {"b": 1, "c": null}, "d": [1, null, 2]}', '$.a', include_arrays => FALSE))
=> "{\"a\":{\"b\":1},\"d\":[1,null,2]}"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(JSON_KEYS(JSON '{"a": {"b": 1, "c": null}, "d": [1, null, 2]}'), ',')
=> "a,a.b,a.c,d"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(JSON_KEYS(JSON '{"a": {"b": 1, "c": null}, "d": [1, null, 2]}', 1), ',')
=> "a,d"

SELECT JSON_KEYS(JSON '{"a": 1}', 0)
=> error:

## Accesses and converts JSON

SELECT FLOAT64(JSON '1', wide_number_mode => 'round')
=> "1.0"

SELECT BOOL(JSON 'true')
=> "true"

SELECT INT64(CAST(NULL AS JSON))
=> null

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON '{"a": {"b": 1}}'.a)
=> "{\"b\":1}"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON '{"a": null}'.a)
=> "null"

SELECT JSON '{"a": null}'.b
=> null

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON '{"": 3}'[''])
=> "3"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON '[1, 2]'[1])
=> "2"

SELECT JSON '[1, 2]'[-1]
=> null

SELECT INT64(JSON '1e2')
=> "100"

SELECT SAFE.INT64(JSON '1.5')
=> null

SELECT SAFE.INT64(JSON '9223372036854775808')
=> null

SELECT SAFE.BOOL(JSON '1')
=> null

SELECT STRING(JSON '"é"')
=> "é"

SELECT FLOAT64(JSON '9007199254740993')
=> "9.007199254740992E15"

SELECT SAFE.FLOAT64(JSON '9007199254740993', wide_number_mode => 'exact')
=> null

SELECT SAFE.FLOAT64(JSON '1', wide_number_mode => 'x')
=> null

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON '{"a": {"b": [10, 20]}}'.a.b)
=> "[10,20]"

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON '{"a": {"b": [10, 20]}}'.a.b[1])
=> "20"

SELECT JSON '{"a": {"b": [10, 20]}}'.a.b[5] IS NULL
=> "true"

SELECT JSON '{"a": {"b": [10, 20]}}'.a.b[-1] IS NULL
=> "true"

SELECT STRING(JSON '{"c d": "x"}'['c d'])
=> "x"

SELECT STRING(JSON '{"c d": "x"}'.missing)
=> null

SELECT INT64(JSON '{"a": {"b": [10, 20]}}'.a.b[0])
=> "10"

SELECT INT64(JSON '2.0')
=> "2"

# A number with a fractional part, or anything but a number, does not convert to INT64.
SELECT INT64(JSON '2.5')
=> error:

SELECT INT64(JSON '{"b": 1}')
=> error:

SELECT FLOAT64(JSON '2.5')
=> "2.5"

SELECT BOOL(JSON '1')
=> error:

SELECT STRING(JSON '1')
=> error:

# Validation order when SQL NULL and invalid JSON_KEYS arguments occur together.
# Expected errors were verified on BigQuery.

SELECT JSON_KEYS(j, 1, mode => 'invalid') FROM UNNEST([CAST(NULL AS JSON)]) AS j
=> error: Invalid JSON mode specified: invalid; error in JSON_KEYS expression

SELECT JSON_KEYS(j, 0, mode => CAST(NULL AS STRING)) FROM UNNEST([CAST(NULL AS JSON)]) AS j
=> error: max_depth must be positive. provided value: 0; error in JSON_KEYS expression

SELECT JSON_KEYS(j, 0, mode => 'invalid') FROM UNNEST([CAST(NULL AS JSON)]) AS j
=> error: Invalid JSON mode specified: invalid; error in JSON_KEYS expression

SELECT SAFE.JSON_KEYS(j, 1, mode => 'invalid') IS NULL FROM UNNEST([CAST(NULL AS JSON)]) AS j
=> error: SAFE with function json_keys is not supported.
